2026-2027 Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS)
The Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS) is a voluntary, self-financed dental service scheme offered through the University’s contracted service providers,
Health & Care Dental Services Limited
and
Quality HealthCare Dental Services Limited
.
The Scheme aims to provide eligible University members with the added convenience of receiving dental services at participating off-campus dental clinics at concessionary rates.  Full-time students, full-time staff and their dependents, as well as eligible retirees and their dependents, are eligible to enroll in the Scheme.
The Scheme is now open for applications.  Membership is valid from
1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027
.
For details of the Scheme, please visit the following webpage:
https://www.umso.cuhk.edu.hk/form-download/
2026-2027
自費牙科服務計劃
「自費牙科服務計劃」是一項自願參加及自行支付費用的牙科保健計劃，由大學委聘的牙科服務提供者
恒健牙科服務有限公司
及
卓健牙科服務有限公司
提供服務。
本計劃旨在為合資格的大學成員提供更便捷的選擇，讓參加者可於校外指定牙科診所享用優惠收費的牙科服務。 全日制學生、全職職員及其家屬、以及合資格退休員工及其家屬均可參加本計劃。

Microsoft Copilot Chat Tips Exam Prep Superpower — AI Study Coach  - ITSC
From: ITSC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
itsc@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Finals week doesn't have to be terrifying. Turn
Copilot Chat
into your
exam prep coach
— custom study guides, practice questions, flashcards, and gap analysis. Study smarter, not harder!
Prompt 1 — copy & paste it!
Custom study guide
"I have an exam on [subject]. Create a study guide with: 1) Key concepts by importance 2) Brief explanations 3) Memory tricks or mnemonics 4) Common exam traps to watch out for."
Prompt 2 — keep the conversation going!

Practice exam
"Generate a 20-question practice exam on [topic] at university-level difficulty. Include: 5 multiple choice, 5 short answer, 5 true/false, and 5 application questions. Provide detailed answer key."
Prompt 3 — go advanced!

Find your weak spots
"Here are my study notes on [topic]: [paste]. Compare against comprehensive understanding. What am I missing? What do I misunderstand? Create 10 targeted questions on my weak areas."
Why this works:
Active recall (testing yourself) is 3x more effective than re-reading notes. Copilot generates unlimited practice questions personalized to YOUR gaps!

Bonus tip:
Night before the exam:
"Give me a 1-page cheat sheet of the 20 most likely exam topics with one-sentence summaries"
— ultimate last-minute review!
Want to enhance your Copilot skills? Check out previous
All IT - Microsoft Copilot Chat Usage Tips
for even more helpful guidance and best practices.

Announcements
【SIGN UP】HKIAPS Lecture Series 【誠邀參與】香港亞太研究所中午大講堂—「利舞台」與香港粵劇（講者：容世誠教授） - Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
From: Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkiaps@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年12月1日（星期二）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓5樓505室
語言：廣東話
講者：容世誠教授（新加坡國立大學中文系榮休教授）
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13746714
講座簡介
利舞台是銅鑼灣的著名地標戲院，於1927年2月正式開業；它見證了香港粵劇史演變、華資商人經濟版圖的擴展，以及香港城市的現代化歷程。本講座分為兩個部分。上半部從富商利希慎購入銅鑼灣地段經營「利園遊樂場」說起，講述利舞台的興建與早期演劇，如何折射出1920年代省港粵劇文化。第二部分則聚焦戰後香港粵劇生態。利舞台於1955年再演粵劇，在民樂公司袁耀鴻支持下，成為著名編劇唐滌生和「仙鳳鳴劇團」銳意革新，提升香港粵劇藝術水平的實驗場地。
講者簡介
容世誠教授，廣東中山人，香港大學中文系文學士、哲學碩士，美國普林斯頓大學博士，曾任教於新加坡國立大學中文系，現為新加坡國立大學中文系榮休教授。研究興趣包括中國戲曲、新加坡華族戲曲、粵劇粵曲史、香港戲曲史、亞洲文化冷戰和聲音文化史等。出版專著有《粵韻留聲：唱片工業與廣東曲藝 (1903–1953) 》(2006年)、《尋覓粵劇聲影：從紅船到水銀燈》(2012年) 、《海內外中國戲劇史家自選集：容世誠卷 》(2018年) 等。

title: Midday Oasis: Music Sharing with Hung Sum Yee 「午間心靈綠洲」:洪心怡音樂分享會
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/11/20
»
Events / Activities
Midday Oasis: Music Sharing with Hung Sum Yee   「午間心靈綠洲」:洪心怡音樂分享會 - Chaplain's Office, Chung Chi College
From: Chaplain's Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
chaplaincy@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【午間心靈綠洲】下星期一, 讓我們以最溫柔的方式迎接一位從崇基出發的聲音。
洪心怡，香港中文大學音樂系、崇基學院畢業生，
2024
年憑藉《花無雪》一曲奪得《校園好聲音——唱響中國》冠軍，被評審稱為「一塊寶玉」。
她以清澈而富有故事感的聲線，正式踏入樂壇，先後推出《你是我的煩惱海》及《零分重作》，迅速成為備受關注的新星。
今日，她帶着那把最真實、最動人的聲音，回到熟悉的崇基禮拜堂。
讓我們一起沉浸在她的歌聲裏，感受音樂最純粹的溫度。
【Midday Oasis
】The coming Monday, we warmly welcome a voice that began its journey right here at Chung Chi.
Hung Sum-yee, a graduate of the CUHK Music Department and Chung Chi College,
rose to prominence in 2024 after winning the championship of
“Campus Voice – Singing Across China” with her captivating performance of Flower Without Snow.
Praised by judges as
“a gem waiting to be polished,”
She has since debuted with the heartfelt singles You Are My Sea of Troubles and Starting Over from Zero, quickly establishing herself as one of Hong Kong
’s most promising new voices.
Today, she returns to the familiar chapel of Chung Chi with the same sincerity and warmth that first captured hearts.
Join us as we let her voice fill the space with pure, honest beauty.
--------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Calling for male participants! Local post-secondary student well-being survey (complete the questionnaire and get a HK$100 voucher) 男同學請進！本地大專生幸福感調查（填問卷攞 HK$100禮券）
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/11/20
»
Announcements
Calling for male participants! Local post-secondary student well-being survey (complete the questionnaire and get a HK$100 voucher) 男同學請進！本地大專生幸福感調查（填問卷攞 HK$100禮券） - JC School of Public Health and Primary Care (endorsed by Prof. Jean H. Kim)
From: Melinda Chuchu Liu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155201160@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你最近過得點樣？生活充實定係空虛？課程有趣但一諗到未來職涯頭都大埋？
親愛的同學們，中大公共衞生及基層醫療學院研究團隊誠邀你參與一項本地大專學生幸福感和心理健康調查。花 15-20 分鐘分享你的幸福感同壓力，完成問卷並通過有效性檢核的受訪者可得 HK$100 百佳/惠康/馬莎禮券！無需準備，亦冇標準答案。我們最想了解的，就係你真實的想法和經歷。
符合以下
4
個條件即可參與：
18-24 歲的男性香港永久性居民
本地全日制學士（Degree）或副學位（Associate/Higher Diploma）課程學生（請在問卷中填寫學生電郵，僅用於資格檢核和發放禮券）
能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文
能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫線上問卷
數據嚴格保密，参与完全自願，可以隨時停止。每位受訪者只能參與和領取酬謝一次。本調查已獲香港中文大學調查及行為研究操守委員會批准（倫理批准編號：SBRE-23-0714）。如有任何疑問、意見或憂慮，歡迎聯絡研究團隊成員劉楚楚（melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk）。
問卷連結
：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY?Q_Language=ZH-T
我們希望是次研究能收集到來自不同背景同學的聲音。如果你身邊有合資格朋友正在副學位課程或其他大專院校就讀，我們懇請你將問卷連結分享給他們，讓他們也能分享自己的感受並領取HK$100禮券！
複製
&
轉發
：中大研究團隊依家做緊「本地大專生幸福感與心理健康調查」，填問卷可領 HK$100 百佳/惠康/馬莎禮券！
誰可以參與？
18-24歲男性香港永久性居民 + 本地全日制學士（Degree）或副學位（Asso/HD）課程學生 + 能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文問卷 + 能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫問卷。
問卷連結
：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY?Q_Language=ZH-T
How have you been recently? Is life fulfilling or empty? Finding classes interesting but having a headache for your future career?
Dear students, the research team from the CUHK School of Public Health and Primary Care cordially invites you to participate in a survey on the well-being and mental health of local post-secondary students.
Spend 15-20 minutes sharing your feelings and concerns and collect a HK$100 gift voucher (choose from PARKnSHOP, Wellcome, or Marks & Spencer) after completing the online survey and passing the validity check! No fancy words needed; no right or wrong answers either. We are interested in your honest experiences and perspectives
You are eligible to participate if you meet these 4 criteria:
Male HK permanent resident aged 18-24
Local full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) or sub-degree (Associate Degree / Higher Diploma) programme student (please enter your institutional email address in the questionnaire, only for eligibility checking and incentive distribution purposes)
Able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English
Able to complete the online survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer
Data is strictly confidential, participation is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time. Each participant may participate and collect their incentive only once. This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Ethics Approval Ref. No.: SBRE-23-0714). If you have any questions, feedback, or concerns, please contact Melinda Chuchu Liu at melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
Survey Link
:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY
We want to make sure that students from diverse backgrounds are represented in this study. If you have eligible friends studying in sub-degree programmes or at other institutions, please share the survey link with them so they can share their feelings and grab a HK$100 voucher too!
Copy & Forward
: The CUHK research team is conducting a survey on the well-being and mental health of local college students. Complete it and grab a HK$100 PARKnSHOP, Wellcome, or Marks & Spencer gift voucher!
Who can participate?
Male HK permanent resident aged 18-24 + local full-time undergraduate/sub-degree student + able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English + able to complete the survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer.
Survey Link
: https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

We are interested in your honest experiences and perspectives You are eligible to participate if you meet these 4 criteria: Male HK permanent resident aged 18-24 Local full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) or sub-degree (Associate Degree / Higher Diploma) programme student (please enter your institutional email address in the questionnaire, only for eligibility checking and incentive distribution purposes) Able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English Able to complete the online survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer Data is strictly confidential, participation is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time.

bodyText:

Announcements
[招募訪談對象 | Recruiting participants for interviews] 誠邀擔任家庭次要收入來源之已婚男士參與訪談！可獲HK$200津貼 | Call for Married Male Secondary Earners for Interviews! Receive a HK$200 honorarium  - Department of Japanese Studies
From: Dr. Huang
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ying.huang@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
「男性賺錢養家、女性照顧家庭」是香港家庭分工的常見模式。香港中文大學日本研究學系正進行一項研究，探討在香港和日本社會，當女性作為家庭主要經濟收入來源時，夫妻雙方的經驗。我們現正誠邀擔任家庭次要收入來源之已婚男士參與訪談。詳情如下：
如您符合以下條件，歡迎報名：
已婚男性
您的女性伴侶（配偶﹑民事伴侶等）擔任家中主要的收入來源
雇傭狀態不限（正在從事工作、全職照顧家庭者、或退休人士等皆可）
年齡20歲或以上
香港居民
訪談詳情
時長：約1～1.5小時
方式：面對面（地點可議）或 線上（Zoom）
語言：廣東話、普通話﹑或英文皆可
津貼： $200港幣現金
報名表格
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdv3uCR0BT1OliKYuoTA8pbsXfJooG_yiFOHK43dRUrKK69Wg/viewform?usp=header
本項目的研究方案已獲得香港中文大學調查及行爲研究操守委員會的倫理審查批准。您為本研究提供的資料僅供研究用途，不會向任何第三方披露。
查詢：黃博士（電郵ying.huang@cuhk.edu.hk；電話：3943 5497）。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
“Men earn money to support the family while women take care of the home” remains a common family arrangement in Hong Kong. The Department of Japanese Studies of the CUHK is conducting a study in Hong Kong and Japan to explore the experiences of couples in which the woman is the primary income earner in the family. We are currently inviting married men who are secondary earners in the household to participate in our interviews.
Criteria
:
Female breadwinner
Married male
Your female partner (spouse, civil partner, etc.) is the primary income earner of the family.
We welcome participants in different employment status (employed, full-time family caregivers, retired, etc.).
Aged 20 or above
Hong Kong resident
Details of interview
Length: About 1 – 1.5 hours
Format: Face-to-face or Online (Zoom)
Language: English, Cantonese, or Putonghua
Honorarium: HK$200 in cash (Transportation subsidies included)
Registration Form
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdv3uCR0BT1OliKYuoTA8pbsXfJooG_yiFOHK43dRUrKK69Wg/viewform?usp=header
The research proposal of this project has obtained the ethical approval from the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of the Chinese University of Hong Kong. Data and personal information you provide for this project will be used solely for the purposes of this research and will not be disclosed to any third parties.
Enquiry: Dr. Huang (Email: ying.huang@cuhk.edu.hk; Phone: 3943 5497).
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20261123)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 23 November to 27 November: (1) Ace Your Oral Presentations, (2) Hong Kong Civil Service Interview Preparation, (3) Taking the IELTS Challenge: Reading & Writing, (5) Taking the IELTS Challenge: Speaking & Listening, (6) Global Citizenship Series: Media and Technology, (7) Happy Hour @ Wine & Cheese or Cheese & Wine?!, and (8) Job Preparation Series: Ace Your In-person and Video Job Interviews. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
23 November (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30
24 November (Tue): 10:30 – 12:30
25 November (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30
26 November (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 23 November to 27 November: (1) JRE Argumentative Writing II, (2) CV & Cover Letter Writing (PTH), and (3) Critical Thinking and Argumentative Writing. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心十一月二十三日至十一月二十七日舉辦 (1) JRE 議論文寫作 (二), (2) 中文求職信及履歷寫作(普), (3) 「信而好古」——粵語與中國古代文化 (粵), 及 (4) 批判思考與論點寫作等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於十一月二十三日至十一月二十七日提供以下中文輔導時段。
24 November (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
25 November (Wed): 14:30 – 16:30
26 November (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
27 November (Fri): 14:30 – 16:30
網上預約：
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
更多中文輔導時段。
====================================
C. “The Power of Words” 「書寫力量」
This is a reading and writing event organized by the ILC, Hong Kong Literature Research Centre, the Office of Arts Administrator (OAA) and Tolopoem. Activities we have this semester include Blackboard / Glass Wall Poems, Talks of Dialogue in the Arts and Workshops.
自學中心、香港文學研究中心、藝術行政主任辦公室及吐露詩社合辦的大型閱讀及寫作活動。這個學期的活動，除黑板詩及玻璃詩外，還有藝文縱談及各式工作坊。各項活動的資料可以參看：https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/Event/thepowerofwords.aspx
====================================
【Independent Online Learning Resources】自學中心網上自學資源
A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing
Visit this link on academic writing skills and convention for different citation styles:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary
Visit this link for both General Vocabulary and Specific Vocabulary (e.g. For Business and Medical Professionals) lists and practices:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.

協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html
- Cantonese Express港式粵語速遞

Announcements
Make the Most of Career Services at the University 善用大學職涯服務 為未來就業做好準備 善用大學職涯服務 為未來就業做好準備 - Career Planning and Development Centre, Office of Student Affairs
From: Rita Yeung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
careeractivities@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Make the Most of Career Services at the University
Career Planning and Development Centre (CPDC) of the Office of Student Affairs (OSA), along with Faculties across the University, is committed to supporting students' career development through a comprehensive range of services, including career advising, résumé and cover letter reviews, mock interviews, career development workshops, alumni sharing, employer engagement activities and co-ordination of job opportunities.
CPDC works closely with employers and industry partners to provide reliable, relevant and student-focused guidance that supports students’ professional aspirations. Through enjoying the University's career services, students have access to a wide range of professional support and resources designed to help them explore future study options and career paths and make informed decisions.
During your career planning process, you may come across various career consulting and job placement services in the market, some of which charge substantial fees. Before engaging any external service providers, students are strongly encouraged to explore the career resources and support available through the University’s official channels.
CU Careers Homepage:
https://cpdc.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/en
Start with your University's official career services and make informed decisions for your career journey.
善用大
學
職涯服務 為未來就業做好準備
學生事務處就業策劃及發展中心以及各學院一直致力為學生提供全面的職涯發展服務，當中包括職涯諮詢、履歷及求職信點評、模擬面試、職業規劃工作坊、校友分享、僱主交流及招聘活動等，旨在協助同學為升學及就業作好準備。
這些服務均由大學官方渠道提供，內容緊貼同學需要。就業策劃及發展中心與各行業僱主及合作夥伴保持聯繫，讓同學獲得可靠、專業及貼近市場需要的支援。
在規劃就業及升學的過程中，同學們或會接觸到不同的求職諮詢或職涯培訓服務，坊間部分服務可能收取高昂費用。然而，在考慮報讀收費職涯課程或委託第三方機構提供求職服務前，請先了解校內已提供的專業支援。
同學可以透過CU Careers網頁了解可獲得的校內資源及支援，作出明智選擇。
CU Careers 網頁:
https://cpdc.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/en

http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Dear all,
You are cordially invited to join a talk on 24 November, in which Prof. Yuqi Chen will discuss an AI-driven game "Into the Painting: Enter Bianjing".
Yuqi Chen is jointly appointed to the Hong Kong Institute for the Humanities and Social Sciences and Faculty of Arts at HKU. She holds a BA and PhD from Peking University and applies Al to historical materials and interactive simulations.
Title: 入畫 清明上河圖 - AI 驅動的開放敘事遊戲 Into the Painting: Enter Bianjing - An AI-driven open narrative game
Speaker: 陳鈺琪教授 Prof. Yuqi Chen (Assistant Professor, Joint Appointment, HKIHSS and Faculty of Arts, University of Hong Kong)

Mode: In-person
Language: 普通話 Mandarin
Venue: Room 401, Humanities Building, New Asia College, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
All interested are welcome. Look forward to seeing you at the Seminar!

bodyText:

Popular Science Special Lecture Series: How Nobel Prizes Are Won 科學普及特別講座：如何獲得諾貝爾獎 - Centre for Promoting Science Education
From: Centre for Promoting Science Education
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cpse@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(The Chinese version of this invitation follows the English version)
The Faculty of Science of The Chinese University of Hong Kong has been dedicated to promoting science to the general public, especially to young people. In addition to our annual Popular Science Talks, where our faculty members give talks on cutting-edge topics of science, we are pleased to hold a special Popular Science Lecture Series on research that covers topics related to this year’s Nobel Prizes in Chemistry and Physiology or Medicine.
This year, the Popular Science Special Lecture Series: How Nobel Prizes Are Won will be held on 11 December 2026 (Friday).
Date:
11 December 2026 (Friday)
Time:
2:30 pm – 4:30 pm
Venue:
LT2, Esther Lee Building, CUHK
(Seats are limited; first-come, first-served)
Registration:
Joining the event is free of charge. Register
HERE
Registration Deadline:
9 December 2026 (Wednesday)
Enquiries:
3943 1387 / cpse@cuhk.edu.hk
Lecture Series Topics:
Talk 1
The Chemistry of Choosing a Mirror Image: How Success Meets Efficiency
Science behind the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026
Prof. KWONG Fuk Yee (Department of Chemistry)
To be conducted in Cantonese
Talk 2
(Part I)
Optogenetics
Science behind the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2026
Prof. DUAN Liting (Faculty of Engineering)
To be conducted in English
Talk 2
(Part II)
Illuminating the Secrets of Brain: Applications of Optogenetics in Neuroscience
Science behind the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2026
Prof. CHEN Zhefan Stephen (School of Life Sciences)
To be conducted in English
There will be a Q&A session after each talk, you may also leave your questions in the registration form in advance. For enquiries, please do not hesitate to contact us at 3943-1387 or
cpse@cuhk.edu.hk
.
======================================================
香港中文大學理學院致力向廣大市民，特別是青年人推廣科學。 除了科學普及講座之外，我們的團隊還會以社會的熱門科學課題進行講座。今年，我們將就本年度頒發的諾貝爾化學獎及生理學或醫學獎舉辦「如何獲得諾貝爾獎」這個特別講座。 目的在於介紹世界級科學研究背後的概念，希望啟發公眾對科學的認識，從而進一步投身科學的領域。
今年，「科學普及特別講座：如何獲得諾貝爾獎」將於2026年12月11日 (星期五) 舉行。
日期：
2026年12月11日 (星期五)
時間：
下午二時三十分至下午四時三十分
地點：
香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓2號演講廳
(
名額有限，先到先得
)
報名：
報名
截止日期：
2026年12月9日 (星期三)
查詢：
3943 1387 / cpse@cuhk.edu.hk
講座題目：
第一場
選擇鏡像的化學：成功與效率的交會
2026年諾貝爾化學獎背後的科學
鄺福兒  教授
(
化學系
)
廣東話主講
第二場
(第一部分)
光遺傳學
2026年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎背後的科學
段麗婷  教授  (工程學院)
英語主講
第二場
(第二部分)
點亮大腦的祕密：光遺傳學在神經科學中的應用
2026年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎背後的科學
陳哲凡  教授  (生命科學院)
英語主講
每場講座完結後均設問答環節，有興趣人士也可預先在報名表格內提交問題。如有任何查詢，歡迎致電3943-1387或電郵至
cpse@cuhk.edu.hk
與我們聯絡。

Announcements
Recruitment of Student Helpers for Ceremony (1 and 2 December 2026) 招募典禮學生工作人員（2026年12月1日及2日） - Office of Institutional Advancement
From: Angela Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
angelalau@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募典禮學生工作人員（2026年12月1日及2日）
拓展及籌募處現正為即將舉行的活動公開招募學生工作人員，協助現場運作與物資支援。歡迎細心、有責任感及具良好溝通能力的同學報名參與。
活動日期：2026年12月1及2日（星期二及星期三）
時薪：HKD 70
備註：如能出席全部兩天工作者，將獲優先考慮。
主要職責：
協助嘉賓登記、簽到及引導接待
協助典禮現場物資維護及遞送
協助場地佈置、物資搬運及復原
支援其他現場突發及營運事宜
我們期望你：
具良好溝通技巧、主動積極且具責任感
守時並能配合現場團隊分工
能全程出席上述工作時段及相關簡報會（暫訂於2026年11月30日以 Zoom 形式舉行）
詳情請參閱
申請表格
上的內容，歡迎有興趣的同學填寫申表格。拓展及籌募處會透過電話聯絡合適的同學及提供更多工作詳情。
如有任何查詢，歡迎與劉小姐聯絡（電郵：
angelalau@cuhk.edu.hk
）
Recruitment of Student Helpers for Ceremony (1 & 2 December 2026)
Office of Institutional Advancement is currently recruiting Student Helpers to provide on-site operational support for an upcoming event. Students who are responsible, detail-oriented, and possess strong communication skills are warmly invited to apply.
Event Dates: 1 & 2 December 2026 (Tuesday & Wednesday)
Hourly Rate: HKD 70
Remarks: Candidates who are available on both days will be given priority consideration.
Main Responsibilities:
Assist with guest registration, reception, and ushering
Provide on-site logistics support
Assist with venue setup, logistics transport, and pack-down
Support other general administrative and ad-hoc on-site tasks
We are looking for candidates who:
Possess strong communication skills, initiative, and a high sense of responsibility
Are punctual and capable of working effectively in a team
Are available for the full working shifts and the online briefing session (tentatively scheduled for 30 November 2026 via Zoom)
For further details, please refer to the
application form
. Interested students are welcome to complete the form. Suitable candidates will be contacted by phone and provided with additional information about the role.
Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact Ms Lau (
angelalau@cuhk.edu.hk
)

[Register Now!] [4 DEC] Areas of Excellence (AoE) Use data to transform diabetes care and patient lives Live Webinar Series (2026-2027)  - Hong Kong Institute of Diabetes and Obesity
From: LAU Wing Man
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkido@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear All,
You’re cordially invited to join
Areas of Excellence (AoE)
Use data to transform diabetes care and patient lives
Live Webinar Series (2026-2027) with the details below
Join us for the
Areas of Excellence (AoE) Live Webinar Series (2026-2027)
which we have invited global leaders and experts in biomedical-psychosocial-behavioral science to share the latest knowledge in epidemiology, diagnosis, prevention and treatment from early to late stage in pursuit of the vision of the Lancet Commission Report on diabetes.
In this monthly webinar, we have invited experts to discuss the challenges and opportunities of implementing data-driven diabetes prevention and care and explore opportunities of setting a Global Diabetes Register using the JADE Platform in our common goal of making healthcare sustainable and helping people live a healthy and better life.
Learning objectives
Understand what, why, how, by whom and for whom of setting up diabetes registers
Set up a network of collaborators to establish a multicounty JADE Register with automatic data anonymization, using common protocol to gather real world evidence, share best practices and improve quality of care
Enable researchers and care providers to work collectively to define the clinical profiles of their population, benchmark their care performance, establish biobanks and implement pragmatic clinical studies to address unmet needs
About the speaker
Professor Melanie Davies
, Professor of Diabetes Medicine, Department of Population Health Sciences, The University of Leicester, Leicester, United Kingdom
Professor Leeling Lim
, Executive Director of Clinical Research and Advancement Universiti Malaya, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Date & time: 4 December 2026 (Friday) | 17:00-18:00 HKT (UTC+8)
Online: via Zoom — link provided upon registration
Register
HERE
To learn more, please visit
HERE
*Please be reminded that no academy accreditation will be provided for this webinar series.*
Don’t miss this opportunity for setting up the JADE Register at your institution with access to the portal for a trial period to explore feasibility.
Acknowledgement of the RGC Area of Excellence Scheme on Diabetes (AoE/M-401/24-R).

Event attendees can enjoy an instant HK$60 discount when purchasing any books or souvenirs at the bookshop on the day of the event.
活動當日，參加者於小書店購買任何書籍或紀念品，可立減60元。
活動簡介：
在《杜甫一生》（
The Life of Tu Fu
）中，作家、翻譯家艾略特‧溫伯格（Eliot Weinberger）沒有選擇直接翻譯杜甫的詩，而是從杜甫一千多首作品中汲取靈感，將其中的詩句、意象與情感重新編織，寫成五十八首全新的詩篇，拼貼出一部關於杜甫的虛構自傳。
戰亂與流離、孤獨與友誼、苦難與生命的短暫……千年前詩人筆下的生命經驗，在溫伯格的重新書寫中獲得了另一種形式，也讓杜甫以新的面貌走進當代讀者的視野。
11月30日，艾略特·溫伯格將與詩人、翻譯家 Jeffrey Yang （楊君磊）相聚香港中文大學出版社，從《杜甫一生》出發，談論詩歌如何跨越語言與時代，一個人的生命如何在另一種語言中重新獲得表達，以及我們今天為何仍然需要閱讀杜甫。
A Life in Poems: Eliot Weinberger and Jeffrey Yang on
The Life of Tu Fu
In
The Life of Tu Fu
, Eliot Weinberger draws on Tu Fu’s poetry, reworking its lines, images, and emotions into fifty-eight new poems. Rather than offering straightforward translations, Weinberger creates a fictional autobiography, weaving together fragments of a life shaped by war, displacement, solitude, friendship, and loss.
More than a millennium later, Tu Fu’s poetry finds a new voice—and a new life—in Weinberger’s reimagining.
On November 30, Weinberger will join Jeffrey Yang at The Chinese University of Hong Kong Press to discuss
The Life of Tu Fu
. Together, they will explore poetry across languages and centuries, the possibilities of translation, and the art of writing a life through poems.
Join us for an intimate literary conversation on Tu Fu and the enduring resonance of his life and work.

Student Helper Recruitment (Parent-child interaction videos coding) 招募學生助理（親子互動視頻編碼） - Department of educational psychology
From: LAN Xi
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
lanxi@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Neurodevelopment and Diversity Lab is looking for Student Helpers to join our research team! This is a great opportunity for students interested in child development and parent-child interactions. We welcome students from all academic backgrounds!
Responsibilities:
Watch parent-child interaction videos and code children’s behaviors and performance using the provided coding scheme.
Student Helpers will also be considered research participants in this project and will be required to sign an informed consent form and a confidentiality agreement for videos they coded.
Requirements:
Students should be undergraduate or postgraduate students at CUHK.
Students should be proficient in Mandarin or Cantonese.
Strong sense of responsibility, patience, and interest in observing parent-child interactions and children’s behaviors.
Open to students from all academic backgrounds. Brief training will be provided.
Work Location:
Chen Kou Bun Building, CUHK or CUHK Shenzhen Research Institute
Working Hours:
A minimum of 4 hours/week and a maximum of 17 hours/week. The working period will typically be concentrated within approximately 1-2 months.
Students who can commit to working a continuous half-day or full-day are preferred.
Other information:
This is a long-term recruitment, with student helpers recruited in batches throughout the year. We encourage applicants to indicate their preferred working months. We will contact you based on your availability and our project schedule to arrange your working period.
How to Apply:
Interested parties please complete the online application form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf_v1K2TDWUD5bl6kWqC36XCkGaOQPYRlbjSqIoAMHraYwctQ/viewform?usp=dialog
We will contact you after we collect the form. Questions or enquiries can be sent to
lanxi@link.cuhk.edu.hk
. Please note that all personal data collected will be used solely for recruitment purposes.

[UGEB2991] Re-running the Four Areas University GE Course: Viewing Communication from Speech Therapy [UGEB2991] 再次開辦課程通識四範圍科目 — 「從言語治療看溝通」 - Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery
From: CHEUK KIT CHING
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你有否試過失聲、聲音沙啞、口齒不清或者口吃？你身邊有沒有人說話不清、患有認知障礙、自閉症、聽力障礙或者中風？你知道如何幫助他們嗎？
每 10 個人中就有一個人患有至少一種溝通障礙。人們在一生中幾乎不可避免地會遇到言語不清、聲音嘶啞、口吃、自閉症譜系障礙、聽力障礙和認知障礙（癡呆）等症狀的人。沒有言語和聽力科學背景的同學，現在你們有機會學習從語言病理學的角度，瞭解人類交流的基本原理及其障礙！由醫學院言語治療科再次開辦的通識四範圍科目 – 「從言語治療看溝通」，將會用13個星期，帶你認識人類交流基本要素、各種溝通障礙的成因和特徵，以及一些跟患者溝通的實用技巧。想透過通識科目擴闊眼界的你，絕對不能錯過：
科目：UGEB2991 從言語治療看溝通
上課時間：逢星期一09:30 – 12:15（2026-27學年下學期）
地點：信和樓UG層2號演講廳
期待你的參與！
如有任何查詢，歡迎電郵至cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk。
Have you ever experienced loss of voice, hoarseness, unclear speech, or stuttering? Do you know someone around you who has unclear speech, cognitive impairments, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment, or has had a stroke? Do you know how to help them?
One in every 10 people suffers from at least one kind of communication disorder. It is almost inevitable for people to have encountered individuals with unclear speech, hoarse voice, stuttering, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment and dementia etc. in their lifetime. For those without a background in speech and hearing sciences, now you can learn more about the fundamentals of communication science from the perspective of speech-language-pathology! The general education course offered by the Division of Speech Therapy, "Viewing Communication from Speech Therapy" is being re-run and will take you through a 13-week journey to explore the essential elements of normal communication, the causes and characteristics of various communication disorders, and practical tips for communicating with patients. If you are eager to broaden your horizons, this is an opportunity you cannot miss:
Course: UGEB2991 Viewing Communications from Speech Therapy
Class Schedule: 09:30 – 12:15, weekly on Monday (Term 2, AY26-27)
Venue: Lecture Theatre 2, UG/F, Sino Building
Looking forward to your participation!
Should you have any queries, please contact us on cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk.

每 10 個人中就有一個人患有至少一種溝通障礙。人們在一生中幾乎不可避免地會遇到言語不清、聲音嘶啞、口吃、自閉症譜系障礙、聽力障礙和認知障礙（癡呆）等症狀的人。沒有言語和聽力科學背景的同學，現在你們有機會學習從語言病理學的角度，瞭解人類交流的基本原理及其障礙！由醫學院言語治療科再次開辦的通識四範圍科目 – 「從言語治療看溝通」，將會用13個星期，帶你認識人類交流基本要素、各種溝通障礙的成因和特徵，以及一些跟患者溝通的實用技巧。想透過通識科目擴闊眼界的你，絕對不能錯過：
科目：UGEB2991 從言語治療看溝通
上課時間：逢星期一09:30 – 12:15（2026-27學年下學期）
地點：信和樓UG層2號演講廳
期待你的參與！
如有任何查詢，歡迎電郵至cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk。
Have you ever experienced loss of voice, hoarseness, unclear speech, or stuttering? Do you know someone around you who has unclear speech, cognitive impairments, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment, or has had a stroke? Do you know how to help them?
One in every 10 people suffers from at least one kind of communication disorder. It is almost inevitable for people to have encountered individuals with unclear speech, hoarse voice, stuttering, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment and dementia etc. in their lifetime. For those without a background in speech and hearing sciences, now you can learn more about the fundamentals of communication science from the perspective of speech-language-pathology! The general education course offered by the Division of Speech Therapy, "Viewing Communication from Speech Therapy" is being re-run and will take you through a 13-week journey to explore the essential elements of normal communication, the causes and characteristics of various communication disorders, and practical tips for communicating with patients. If you are eager to broaden your horizons, this is an opportunity you cannot miss:
Course: UGEB2991 Viewing Communications from Speech Therapy
Class Schedule: 09:30 – 12:15, weekly on Monday (Term 2, AY26-27)
Venue: Lecture Theatre 2, UG/F, Sino Building
Looking forward to your participation!
Should you have any queries, please contact us on cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk.

The programme combines academic theory with real-world business practice through innovative courses in AI, machine learning, digital marketing and marketing analytics, alongside hands-on practicums, industry projects and company visits.
Graduates are well prepared for diverse career opportunities across technology, FMCG, consulting, finance, education and other industries, with employers including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, P&G, L’Oréal and Deloitte.
Study in Hong Kong, one of Asia’s most dynamic international business and financial hubs. Gain valuable insights into both Hong Kong and the Chinese Mainland markets while building a global perspective in an international learning environment.

From: MPhil and PhD Programmes in Public Health Enquiry

CUHK PhD in Public Health
香港中文大學
公共衛生哲學博士課程
Dear Professors, Colleagues, Students,
The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) is a government initiative to support outstanding students from around the world (including local HK) to study in Hong Kong. For Intake 2027-28, the academic year starts on 1 August 2027.
We would like to invite excellent students to apply for CUHK PhD programme in Public Health and welcome students to apply for HKPFS. These provide opportunities to study full-time with financial support in Hong Kong.
Please note that both application deadlines are on December 1, 2026.
Our research themes include:
•          Non-communicable disease and aging, and Family Medicine & Primary Healthcare
•          Environmental health and infectious diseases
•          Global health policy, health system & healthcare delivery
•          Mental well-being, social & health behaviours
•          Bioinformatics, machine learning and big data
CUHK HKPFS offers:
- HKPFS stipend at HK$344,400 (approx. US$44,200) per year; Up to HK$1.38 Million (approx. US$176,620)
- Conference and Research-related Travel Allowance is HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,850) per year; Up to HK$87,600 (approx. US$11,230)
- And CUHK Vice-Chancellor HKPFS Scholarship - an award of total HK$80,000 (approx. US$10,260)
- Tuition Fee Waiver - Up to HK$198,0000 (approx. US$25,390)
- Lodging Award - Up to HK$100,000 (approx. US$12,820)
- 1st Year Accommodation Fee Waiver and Guaranteed On-campus Accommodation
Step 1: To submit an initial application to RGC. Application deadline: 1 Dec 2026 at 12:00 noon (GMT+8, Hong Kong Time); and
Step 2: To submit full application to CUHK. Application deadline: 1 Dec 2026 at 11:59pm (GMT+8, Hong Kong Time).
Would you like to apply in this year?
Or would you have friends, classmates, colleagues, international collaborators, research partners and etc. who might have an interest in pursuing CUHK PhD in Public Health? Would you mind forwarding the following to them please?
Details of PhD programme in Public Health can be found on webpage
https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/programme/medicine#mphil-phd-in-public-health
or
https://sphpc.cuhk.edu.hk/rpg-programme/
For more info about our School’s Research Themes and list of on-going grants, please refer to webpage

https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/scholarships-fees/scholarships

18歲至24歲青少年,

能說流利的廣東話
使用智慧型手機（附錄音機）並可持續存取互聯網

通過篩查訪談後，在手機

和

，在應用程式分別回答4個指導性問題

From: Centre for Communication and Public Opinion Survey
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ccpos@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Focus Group Invitation - " Service and Complaint Handling of Insurance Company"
Background of the Study
The quality of service and complaint handling of insurance companies are closely related to the interests of the general public. In this connection, the Insurance Authority has commissioned the CUHK Centre for Communication and Public Opinion Survey to conduct a focus group discussion on " Service and Complaint Handling of Insurance Company"
Objective of the Study
The general public’s perception of the insurance sector is closely associated with the quality of service and complaint handling of insurance companies. What are the public experiences when interacting with insurance companies? What expectations do the public hold regarding the services provided? Are they satisfied with the insurance companies’ current processes for resolving issues raised by the public and complaint handling? This focus group will gather insights from the public to better understand their views, experiences, and expectations concerning the service quality and complaint handling of insurance companies.
Target:
Hong Kong permanent residents aged 18 or above
Language:
Cantonese
Date:
Early-December 2026, weekdays (Monday to Friday)
Time:
6:45 PM to 8:45 PM
Venue:
23/F, FOYER, 625 King’s Road, North Point, Hong Kong (Insurance Authority North Point Office)
Duration:
Approximately 2 hours
Incentives:
Each participant will receive a remuneration of cash coupon valued HK$400 for the participation
Remarks:
The discussion will be audio-recorded. The personal data of participants will be kept confidential. The personal data collected will only be used for the discharge of statutory functions of the Insurance Authority and the analysis purposes under the protection of applicable laws, and will not be disclosed to public.
If you are interested in participating in the Focus Group, please fill in the form below:
https://cuhkcom.au1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9YtFlb2jObEgOtU
Enquiries：CUHK Centre for Communication and Public Opinion Survey - Mr. Chow (Email: yattungchow@cuhk.edu.hk; Tel: 3943 1787)

的
服務及投訴處理
研究背景：
保險公司的服務質素及投訴處理，與市民的切身利益息息相關。就此，保險業監管局委託中大傳播與民意調查中心進行一項關於「保險公司的服務及投訴處理」的焦點小組訪問。
研究目的：
市民對保險業界的印象，與保險公司的服務質素及投訴處理有著密切關係。從市民的角度出發，保險公司提供的服務體驗是怎樣的？市民對保險公司有什麼期望？他們對保險公司現時解決市民提出的問題及其投訴處理滿意嗎？本次焦點小組討論，旨在了解市民對保險公司的服務質素和投訴處理的看法及期望。

18歲以上的香港永久居民

廣東話

title: Let's listen to some music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/11/20
»
Announcements
Let's listen to some music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion  - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
18 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Looking to express yourself through words and enjoy a cozy afternoon? Join CUriosity for an inspiring Poetry Workshop!
Poetry isn’t just about rules and rhymes. This workshop provides a space to explore your thoughts, share stories, and connect with creative minds. Whether you’re an experienced poet or completely new to writing, everyone is welcome!
We are delighted to have Collier Nogues (from ENGE department) as our facilitator to guide us through playful, provoking, and easy-to-follow writing activities! Check out her personal website for more her works:
https://www.colliernogues.com/
Here is what you can look forward to:
Build creative connections.
Learn about poetry & have fun writing your own verses!
Free snacks while letting your creativity flow!
Date: 27 November (Friday)
Time: 3:30 – 5:00 pm
Venue: WMY 303
Registration:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFxgyaeZCnMJMmwkWnAJrKdJtJM8UfZh8LjQDcnPjKQJjw8w/viewform

Announcements
(Earn $700!!!) Recruiting adults aged 18–65 who have recovered from depression to participate in a study on depression recurrence (participants on medication are welcome if condition is medically stable)  (獲得 $700!!!) 誠邀年齡介乎18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者參與預測抑鬱症復發相關的研究(歡迎仍在服藥但病情穩定者參加) - Department of Psychiatry
From: Phoebe Chan
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，探討運用語音分析能否預測抑鬱症復發。現招募年齡介乎18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者參與研究。詳情如下：
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
18歲至65歲的抑鬱症康復者
廣東話為母語
使用智慧型手機並可持續連接互聯網
接受本研究所使用的即時通訊應用程式的服務條款和隱私權政策
您需要做什麼？
接受臨床評估作為篩查
填寫問卷
連續
7
天
於指定的手機應用程式以語音方式記錄情緒狀態
一年後接受跟進臨床評估
完成整個實驗及跟進評估，可以獲得最多HK$700作為研究津貼
如有興趣參與研究，請按以下連結填寫篩選問卷。
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_e9b0QXbpcuCUxrE
若您適合參與研究，研究人員會聯絡您解釋研究詳情。
閣下留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp:(+852- 53202853)。

From: Pam
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wenjiepan@cuhk.edu.hk

研究目的: 本研究旨在評估脈衝電磁場治療對跟腱病病患者的治療效果。
研究對象: 1. 年齡18歲或以上
2. 中段跟腱病患者患者
3. 維多利亞體育學院評估—跟腱問卷：跟腱炎的嚴重程度指數<60
內容: 脈衝電磁場治療+足部功能評估+ 復健治療
脈衝電磁場治療（PEMF）係一種無痛、非入侵性嘅新療法，研究顯示可以：
快速減輕疼痛同腫脹
促進跟腱自然修復，等你好返得更快
改善血液循環，等你可以重新輕鬆行路、行山、做運動
無需食藥、無副作用，科學實證有效！ 現誠邀您參加臨床研究，親身體驗PEMF嘅效果。
地點: 沙田威爾斯親王醫院
有興趣的參加者，請在網上登記並且填寫1份篩查問卷:
https://qualtricsxmjfcmmgpdf.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3eYVkGnolhErPAG
參加者於網上登記時留下的資料僅供研究用途，所有資料將會保密。經過篩選後，研究員會以電話或WhatsApp主動聯絡合資格者，並進一步解釋治療詳情。如有任何查詢，請聯絡研究人員辦公室電話:
2636 4171
This study aims to evaluate the effect of a Pulsed Electro-Magnetic Field Therapy for Midportion Achilles Tendinopathy
Target participant:
1. > 18 years old
2. mid- Achilles tendinopathy patients
3. VISA-A score <60
Content: Pulsed electromagnetic field therapy (PEMF)+ rehabilitation exercises
Venue: Prince of Wales Hospital, Shatin, Hong Kong.
Interested participants, please fill out the following questionnaire:
https://qualtricsxmjfcmmgpdf.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3eYVkGnolhErPAG
If you are qualified we will contact you by phone or WhatsApp. If you have any enquiry about the study, please contact number:
2636 4171

title: [Tired of Nightmares and Insomnia?] Join Our Free Online Treatment Study 【成日發惡夢又瞓唔著？】全新網上治療研究，6周助你重拾安睡
bodyText:

2026/11/20
»
Announcements
[Tired of Nightmares and Insomnia?] Join Our Free Online Treatment Study 【成日發惡夢又瞓唔著？】全新網上治療研究，6周助你重拾安睡 - Department of psychiatry
From: Reyane Ao
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
您是否正飽受
惡夢
與
失眠
的雙重困擾，覺得身心俱疲？
反覆的惡夢有機會加劇失眠問題，導致日頭精神大打折扣。
我們誠邀您參與一項
【網上認知行為療法治療噩夢與失眠共病】臨床研究
。本研究旨在評估一項手機應用程式的自助式網上療程，學習有效改善睡眠、減少惡夢的心理療法。
您的參與不僅有機會能幫助自己重獲優質睡眠，更能推動睡眠醫學的發展，為有同樣困擾的人士帶來新的證據。

我們正在招募
年齡介乎 18 至 64 歲
同時受失眠及惡夢問題困擾
能閱讀繁體中文並以粵語溝通

研究內容包括
臨床訪談及問卷篩查
為期6周網上認知行為治療課程（每週約20-30分鐘課程）
完成治療後的問卷和跟進評估
佩戴睡眠手錶

參與方法
如有興趣，請點擊以下連結，花1-2分鐘填寫篩選問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_dbt7HLJzt16miEK

重要提示
初步符合條件者，我們的研究團隊將在
一個月
內與您聯繫，進行後續評估並詳細說明研究詳情。若未獲通知，暫不符合本次招募範圍，敬請諒解。

查詢及聯絡
如有任何疑問，歡迎通過以下方式聯繫研究團隊：
WhatsApp/電話：6763 1454
電郵：
sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
您提供的所有資料將會嚴格保密，僅供本研究使用。
歡迎將此信息轉發
給可能有需要的人士。感謝您的關注與支持！
Dear Sir/Madam,
Are you struggling with both nightmares and insomnia, feeling mentally and physically exhausted?
Recurring nightmares can make insomnia even worse, severely affecting your sleep quality and leaving you drained during the day.​
We invite you to take part in a clinical study on an
online cognitive behavioural therapy program for co-occurring nightmares and insomnia
. This study aims to evaluate an innovative mobile application–based treatment. Through this free and convenient self-help online program, you can learn evidence-based psychological techniques to improve your sleep and reduce nightmares.​
Your participation not only offers you a chance to achieve better sleep but also contributes to advancing sleep medicine, helping to build new evidence for others facing similar challenges.
Who we are recruiting
​
Aged between 18 and 64
Experiencing both insomnia and recurrent nightmares
Able to read Traditional Chinese and communicate in Cantonese​
What the study involves
​
Clinical interview and screening questionnaires
A 6-week online cognitive behavioural therapy program (requiring approximately 20-30 minutes per week)
Post-treatment questionnaires and follow-up assessments​
Wearing a research-grade sleep monitoring device (activity level tracker)
How to Participate
If you are interested, please click the link below to complete a brief screening questionnaire:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_dbt7HLJzt16miEK
Important Note
Only applicants who preliminarily meet the eligibility criteria will be contacted by our research team within one month for further assessment and a detailed study explanation. We appreciate your understanding.
Enquiries & Contact
For any questions, please feel free to contact our research team, via:
WhatsApp/Phone: 6763 1454
Email: sleepresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
All information you provide will be kept strictly confidential and used solely for research purposes.
Please feel free to share this opportunity
with anyone who might benefit. Thank you for your interest and support!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

title: ‼Free Prostate Health Screening ‼ 免費前列腺健康篩查－誠邀合資格男士參加
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/11/20
»
Events / Activities
‼Free Prostate Health Screening ‼ 免費前列腺健康篩查－誠邀合資格男士參加 - S.H. Ho Urology Centre, Department of Surgery
From: Yellow Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
根據衛生署數據，前列腺癌是本港男性常見的癌症之一。透過及早篩查，可以有效降低相關的健康風險。本次活動由中大何善衡泌尿中心舉辦，為合資格人士提供免費的前列腺特異抗原 (PSA) 檢測服務。
活動地點： 沙田區（詳細地址將於成功報名後通知）
活動內容：(所需時間約一小時)
1. 影片講解：深入淺出地介紹前列腺增生及前列腺癌的檢查與治療知識。
2. 前列腺篩查：合資格人士可獲免費前列腺特異抗原（PSA）測試乙次.
• 測試方式：我們將以指尖採血方式為參加者抽取血液樣本，並透過PSA檢測機進行現場測試，約十分鐘即可得知結果。
參加資格：
• 性別：男性
• 年齡：50-75歲
• 從未接受前列腺相關檢查
如有興趣參加活動，請填妥以下表格。
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
如想了解更多關於前列腺癌風險的評估, 可瀏覽以下網址;
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cance
r
參加者提供的所有資料將會被保密。如有任何查詢，請與我們聯絡 （Whatsapp: 5160 6904；電郵：yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk）。
According to data from the Department of Health, prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers among men in Hong Kong. Early screening can effectively reduce related health risks. This event is organized by the S.H. Ho Urology Centre of CUHK, providing free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) testing services for eligible individuals.
Event Venue: Shatin District (the exact address will be provided after successful registration)
Event Details: (Estimated duration: about one hour)
Video Presentation: An easy-to-understand introduction to the examination and treatment of prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia
Prostate Screening: Eligible participants will receive one free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) test.
Testing Method: We will collect blood samples from participants via a fingertip blood test and conduct an on-site PSA test using a PSA testing device. Results will be available in about ten minutes.
Eligibility:
Gender: Male
Age: 50-75 years old
Have never undergone any prostate-related examination
If you are interested in participating, please fill in the online form below;
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
For more information about the assessment of prostate cancer risk, please visit the following website:
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cancer
All information provided by participants will be kept confidential. For any enquiries, please contact us (WhatsApp: 5160 6904; Email: yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

CUHK Research Recruitment | 12-Week Exercise & Thermoregulation Study
Join Our 12-Week Exercise Programme and Discover Your Fitness & Thermoregulation!

Upon completion of the study, participants will receive:
·
HK$200 Shopping Voucher
·
Sports Watch
·
Personalised Fitness & Physiological Assessment Report
·
12 Weeks of Professional Exercise Guidance and Follow-up (Exercise Groups)
The Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at
The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
is recruiting
healthy adults aged 18–40
to participate in a 12-week exercise and heat tolerance research study!
Study Purpose
Can regular exercise improve not only physical fitness and overall health, but also the body's ability to regulate temperature and thermoregulation?
This study aims to investigate how different exercise training programmes affect
physical fitness, exercise capacity, and thermoregulatory responses
.
Who Can Participate?

18–40 years old
, males and females welcome
Ethnic Chinese
BMI between
18.5–25.0 kg/m²
Physically inactive or without a regular exercise routine
Generally healthy and suitable for exercise training and fitness testing
Additional health and safety eligibility criteria will be assessed before formal enrolment.
What Does the Study Involve?
Eligible participants will be
randomly assigned
to one of four groups:
1.     High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)
2.     Moderate-Intensity Continuous Training (MICT)
3.     Low-Intensity Walking (WALK)
4.     Control Group
Participants assigned to the exercise groups will complete a
12-week training programme with 3 sessions per week
, supported by trained exercise professionals and research staff.
Study assessments include:
·       Body composition (muscle and fat mass)
·       Cardiorespiratory fitness and exercise capacity
·       Muscular strength
·       Physical activity and dietary habits
·       Thermoregulation and heat tolerance testing (approximately 30 minutes of walking in a controlled warm environment)
·       Blood sampling before and after the thermoregulatory assessment
Assessment Schedule:
Before the intervention, at Week 6, at Week 12, and at an additional follow-up approximately 4 months later.
Participant Benefits
HK$200 Shopping Voucher + Sports Watch + Personalised Assessment Report
Participants in the exercise groups will also receive 12 weeks of professional exercise guidance and follow-up support!
Study Location
Department of Sports Science and Physical Education
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Sha Tin, Hong Kong

Scan the QR code on the poster to register!
Potentially eligible participants will be contacted by the research team for further screening and assessment arrangements.
Contact: Mr. Chen
WhatsApp:
5534 4775
Email:
chenyonghui0601@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Data Privacy: All information collected will be used for research purposes only, kept strictly confidential, and analysed using de-identified data.
Feel free to share this opportunity with friends who may be interested in supporting exercise science research!

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:

From: Winifred Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學精神科學系正進行一項研究，旨在評估手機應用程式網上自助心理健康療程對改善青年睡眠及情緒健康的成效。現招募年齡介乎15歲至24歲青年研究。詳情如下:
我們誠邀符合以下條件的人士參與本次研究：
1. 15歲至24歲青年
2. 有失眠及情緒症狀
3. 過去三個月沒有接受失眠及情緒心理治療或藥物治療
您需要做什麼？
參與為期6週的手機App自助療程
每週觀看20分鐘左右的網上療程
完成四次網上問卷及七天睡眠日記，包括治療前、治療後、三個月跟進及六個月跟進
全部評估及治療皆在電話或網上進行，無需面見！
如有興趣，請即登記並填寫簡單的網上篩查問卷：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
研究小組將會聯絡適合參與本研究的人士並進一步解釋研究詳情。閣下登記時留下的資料僅供研究用途，絕對保密。如閣下對是項研究有任何查詢，請電郵
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
或 WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 黃小姐)查詢。
The Department of Psychiatry at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is conducting a research study to evaluate the effectiveness of an online self-help mobile app program for improving sleep and emotional well-being among youths. We would like to invite participants aged between 15 and 24 to join the study. Details are as follows:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Youths aged between 15-24 years
2. Experience symptoms of insomnia and emotional distress
3. Have not received psychological or medication treatment for these issues in the past 3 months
What will you do?
Join a 6-week self-help treatment via mobile app
Attend 20 minutes of online therapy weekly
Complete four online surveys and seven-day sleep diary: before treatment, after treatment, at 3-month follow-up, and at 6-month follow-up during the study
All assessments and treatments are conducted via phone or online — no in-person visits required!
If you are interested, please register and complete a short screening questionnaire here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_domAhEzzCmdV2sK
The research team will contact eligible participants and further explain the details of the study. Information collected will be only used for research purpose and will be kept strictly confidential. If you have any enquiries, please contact us via email
winifredtywong@cuhk.edu.hk
or WhatsApp: (+852- 47544464 Miss Wong).
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

【SIGN UP】HKIAPS Lecture Series no.23 【誠邀參與】香港亞太研究所中午大講堂—全球中國與香港華商菁英（三）：馮秉芬爵士與戰後香港的國際化（講者：李培德教授） - Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
From: Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkiaps@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年12月4日（星期五）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓5樓505室
語言：廣東話
講者：李培德教授
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13746547
講者簡介：
香港出生，先後出任香港大學亞洲研究中心專職研究員、香港大學現代語言及文化學院名譽教授、香港科技大學人文學部客座教授、華中師範大學和華僑大學特聘教授。近期著作包括：《香港華商菁英馮秉芬爵士》（2026）；Networks of Power and Wealth in the Cantonese Pacific: The Yips and the Kwoks, 1864-1949（合著，2027年刊）；〈被遺忘的滬港紡織工業家——以厲樹雄自傳來討論〉（2026）；〈香港紅色金融家鄭鐵如與建國前後中國銀行港行資產轉移問題〉（2025）；〈產業鏈和族群網路——香港潮商廖寶珊的崛起，1948至1960年〉（2024）。
講座簡介：
香港華商活躍於慈善、公益和教育事業，並非罕見。馮秉芬爵士素有香港的公職王、慈善家之稱，由他所組織或參與的包括社會慈善和文教公益活動，可謂多不勝數，但最容易被忽略的是他對宣傳香港，推動香港成為國際知名城市的貢獻。本演講的目的，不僅在於梳理馮秉芬爵士一生在社會事業方面的建樹，更在於探討戰後香港能夠成功國際化的重要關鍵。

From: Divinity School of Chung Chi College

正在考慮裝備自己、回應呼召，展開神學學習嗎？誠邀您出席我們的課程資訊日，親臨校園與教授交流！

認識本院：了解神學院辦學理念與學習環境

答問環節：即場解答您對報讀與學習的疑問
聖堂導賞：實地參觀校園
豐富收穫：參與者更可獲贈紀念品一份！

時間：上午10:30 – 下午12:45
地點：香港中文大學崇基學院神學樓 G01室
語言：粵語及英語 (*粵語環節設華語傳譯)
費用：全免

"Learn and Explore" Information Day
Are you considering equipping yourself, responding to a calling, and embarking on a journey of theological study? We cordially invite you to join our Information Day to visit our campus and connect directly with our faculty!
Program Highlights Include:
Introduction to DSCCC: Learn about our mission, vision, and learning environment
Programme Introductions: In-depth information on academic programmes and admission requirements (grouped by intended programme)
Q&A Session: Get immediate answers to your queries regarding admissions and studies
Campus Tour: Guided tour around the Theology Building and Divinity School Chapel
Souvenir: Every participant will receive a special souvenir!

Language: Cantonese & English (*Mandarin interpretation provided for Cantonese sessions)

Announcements
Forest therapy study participant recruitment [Free participation, round-trip transportation provided, complete all questionnaires and receive HKD 50] 森林浴研究參與者招募【免費參與米埔森林浴活動，包來回交通，完成所有問卷可獲HKD50報酬】 - The Department of Geography and Resource Management
From: CHEN Mingjia
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
Mingjia.Chen@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
您有否留意到，大自然往往能讓人放鬆心情、恢復活力，甚至帶來新的啟發？
您想暫時放下忙碌的生活節奏，到米埔親近大自然，為自己充充電嗎？
2026年12月至2027年2月，項目組將於米埔自然保護區舉辦一系列面向公眾開放的森林浴活動，目前正開放第一輪報名。
本項目為香港中文大學一項博士研究的一部分，並透過 WWF「智慧濕地管理計劃」轄下的「身心健康倡議」推行。該計劃由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金捐助支持。項目誠邀年滿18歲人士參與於米埔自然保護區舉行的「自然療癒研究計劃」，共同探索沉浸於自然環境如何促進個人身心健康與生活轉變。
活動詳情
地點：
米埔自然保護區
活動時間：
約 3 小時
活動日期：
詳見報名問卷
每團人數：
最多 15 人 （名額有限，先到先得）
參加對象：
18歲或以上人士
活動語言：
廣東話
費用：
全免
交通：
提供由大學站往返米埔的交通
研究參與
體驗森林浴活動外，您亦會獲邀填寫兩份問卷。問卷分為兩個階段：您將於活動當日填寫一份現場問卷，並於活動結束兩個月後收到填寫回訪問卷的邀請。
完成回訪問卷後，您將收到港幣
50
元作為報酬。
您的回答將有助研究團隊了解自然體驗如何影響個人身心健康、情緒及生活轉變，並為未來自然療癒和身心健康活動提供參考。
如何報名？
目前開放5個活動場次，以下為報名連結。歡迎大家按自己的時間安排，選擇合適的場次報名。為了讓更多朋友有機會參與，每位參加者請只選擇其中一場。
我們將於您提交問卷後一週內與您確認報名結果。以下時間已包括集合及往返大學站的時間。
2026年12月13日（週日）， 9:15 am - 1:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eQK21yhHZGe5Dwi
2026年12月21日（週一），12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_bOrrUdkD4miqVfg
2027年1月2日（週六），12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9RbpRCitsyse1p4
2027年1月12日（週二），9:15 am - 1:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2gFbXLNAwHqL7jE
2027年1月13日（週三），12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0JJPsymZYMbkFXE
*WWF將預先為參加者申請「進入米埔自然護理區許可證」。需麻煩您在報名時提供姓名及身份證明文件號碼的前4位字符，以便辦理相關登記，非常感謝您的理解。
所有收集資料只作研究用途及保密處理。 您有權在研究過程中的任何階段退出研究。如有任何疑問，請聯繫陳小姐（
Mingjia.Chen@link.cuhk.edu.hk
)。
Take a break from your busy routine and reconnect with nature through forest therapy at Mai Po!
This project forms part of a PhD study and is supported by WWF's Mental Wellness Initiative under the Smart Wetland Management Project, supported by The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust.
The first round of recruitment includes five sessions.
The 3-hour session will be conducted in Cantonese and is free of charge. We will provide transport between University Station and Mai Po.
​The activity is open to individuals aged 18 or above. Each session has a maximum of 15 places, allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. We will confirm your registration status within one week of your questionnaire submission.
Registration links
Five activity sessions are currently open for registration. Please find the registration links below and choose a session that best suits your schedule. To give more people the opportunity to participate, we kindly ask that each participant register for one session only. Each session has a maximum of 15 places, allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
We will confirm your registration status within one week of your questionnaire submission. The activity schedule includes the time for meeting up and returning to University Station.
12 Dec 2026 (Sun), 9:15 am - 1:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eQK21yhHZGe5Dwi
21 Dec 2026 (Mon), 12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_bOrrUdkD4miqVfg
2 Jan 2027 (Sat), 12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9RbpRCitsyse1p4
12 Jan 2027 (Tue), 9:15 am - 1:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2gFbXLNAwHqL7jE
13 Jan 2027 (Wed), 12:15 pm - 4:30 pm
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0JJPsymZYMbkFXE
In addition to participating in the forest bathing activity, you will also be invited to complete questionnaires at two stages. You will complete the first questionnaire on-site after the activity, followed by an invitation to complete a follow-up questionnaire two months later.
You will receive HK$50 upon completion of the follow-up questionnaire.
Your participation is valuable and will contribute to research on the relationship between nature experiences, well-being, and personal transformation.
*WWF will apply for the Mai Po Nature Reserve Entry Permit on behalf of participants in advance. Please provide your name and the first 4 characters of your identity document number when registering, and bring the relevant document on the activity day for verification. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
We will keep all collected information confidential and use it only for research purposes. You have the right to withdraw from the study at any time. If you have any questions, please contact Ms. Chen (Mingjia.Chen@link.cuhk.edu.hk).
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Amid the hustle and bustle of campus life, bringing your own water bottle cutlery, lunch box and reusable shopping bag not only helps reduce the use of disposable items, but also reminds us to pause, take care of our well-being and recharge our minds and bodies. Read this issue of ‘Waste-free News’ and discover how simple everyday items can help bring mindfulness and sustainable living into your daily campus life.
在繁忙的校園生活中，自備水樽 餐具、餐盒 和環保袋 不僅有助減少即棄用品，更能提醒我們適時停下來，照顧身心健康 立即閱讀今期的《零廢快訊》，一起探索如何透過簡單的日常用品 把正念與 可持續生活融入校園日常。

  [Online experiment] Looking for native English speakers
Prof. Haerim Hwang (Department of English, CUHK) is looking for participants for a study on language production.
Which participants are we looking for?
- English is your first/native and dominant language
- Your graduate degree is not in the field of linguistics
- Can use your laptop/computer and have access to stable internet (no smartphones, laptops, or hotspot)
- Can participate in an experiment on Zoom in a quiet environment
- Have Chrome on your laptop/computer
How do I participate?
1. Fill out this questionnaire
-- English speakers: https://forms.gle/ttuhGGCwRx2n95kBA
2. Our research team will reach out to you, confirming your availability.
3. It will take approximately 2 hours to complete these tasks.
What do I get out of the study?
You will get HK$250 in cash upon the completion of the task.
Your participation will enhance our understanding of how people process English sentences.
Questions?
Contact Prof. Haerim Hwang at haerimhwang@cuhk.edu.hk
Ethics Approval
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee SBREC (fssc02@cuhk.edu.hk) has vetted the study (Approval ID: SBRE-22-0026D). If you have any concerns regarding ethics, please contact them.

bodyText:

Announcements
[Max. HKD$1200] Recruiting Native Cantonese-speaking Grandparents with hearing loss and Grandchildren for an Interaction Experiment [最高可獲HKD$1200][長者認知及聽力測試報告 + 兒童IQ智商測試報告] 招募聽力損失長者及其孫子女參與互動實驗 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: LEUNG Mei Yee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
我們是
香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（BMI）
的研究團隊。我們團隊誠摯邀請有聽力損失的長者及其孫子女來參與一項互動研究。
參與者需符合以下條件：
長者：
65歲或以上，存在聽力損失，
無其他已知認知障礙症狀， 且
有意願配戴助聽器
孩童：
6-9歲
，無其他已知發展問題，母語為廣東話
實驗內容：本實驗共分為兩節（每節約1.5至2小時）：
- 第一節：長者將獨自參與一項
認知及聽力檢測
（當日孫子女無需到場）
- 第二節：長者將與孫子女一同進行
簡單遊戲
，期間我們將使用安全且非侵入性的
「近紅外光譜儀」（fNIRS）
進行腦部掃描
- 請注意：參與者必須先完成第一節的實驗，且結果符合研究要求，方會獲邀參與第二節的實驗
完成整個實驗後，您可獲得：
- 長者：一份
認知能力測試報告
+ 一份
純音聽力測試報告
- 孩童：一份
非語言智商測試報告
+ 一份
價值HKD$80的禮物
報酬：
現金HKD$400-1200
，以及免費停車券（如適用）
實驗地點：香港中文大學大腦與認知研究所（位於校園內）
如您對本研究感興趣，請點擊以下連結填寫報名表格：
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
如祖孫兩位初步符合條件，我們將會儘快與您聯絡！
如有疑問，請發送電郵至 meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk，
亦可致電或Whatsapp 95867123 查詢。
我們期待你的參與！
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are researchers from the
Brain and Mind Institute (BMI) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong
. Our team sincerely invites grandparents with hearing loss and their grandchildren for a social interaction study.
Participants need to be:
- Grandparent:
65+ years old with hearing loss
, with no other diagnosed cognitive impairment, interested in fitting hearing aids
- Grandchild:
6-9 years old
with no other developmental problems; speaking Cantonese as the first language
What is involved? The experiment consists of two sessions (approx. 1.5-2 hours each):
- Session 1: The grandparent will participate alone in a
cognitive and hearing test
. (The grandchild does not need to attend)
- Session 2: The grandparent and grandchild will participate together in some
simple games
while using
fNIRS
(
functional near-infrared spectroscopy
, safe and non-invasive!!!) brain scanning device
- NOTE: Participants must first complete Session 1 and meet the study's requirements to be invited to Session 2
What you'll get (upon completion of the entire study):
- For the grandparent:
A cognitive test report
and
a pure-tone audiometry
(hearing test) report
- For the child:
An non-verbal IQ test report
and
a gift (~HKD$80)
Reward:
HKD$400-1200 allowance
and free parking ticket.
Location: Brain and Mind Institute, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (In campus).
If you are interested in our study, please fill in the form below via the following link:
https://ci.cuhk.edu.hk/surveys/?s=LJEXMFLMR79XA7TX
We will contact you afterwards if the dyad are suitable.
For inquiries, please contact: meiyeeleung424@cuhk.edu.hk,
call or Whatsapp 95867123.
We look forward to your participation!
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Announcements
【Central obesity management】 Recruiting individuals with central obeisty aged 40-64 in the study  【中央肥胖管理】 中央肥胖改善計劃誠邀40-64歲合資格人士參與 - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education; Program Director: Prof. Eric Tsz-chun POON
From: HE Ye
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學體育運動科學系誠邀中央肥胖人士參與健康管理研究！
研究目的：
中央肥胖與血糖異常、心血管疾病及其他代謝健康問題的風險增加有關。為應對這一公共健康挑戰，香港中文大學體育運動科學系正開展健康生活方式計劃，提供個人化健康支援。
參加條件：
年齡：40-64歲
平時少做運動/無規律運動習慣
中央肥胖：男性腰圍 ≥ 90 cm; 女性腰圍 ≥ 80 cm
過去三個月體重變動≤5%
現時沒有服用長期藥物
參加方法：
掃描海報二維碼或通過鏈接作網上登記【
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
】
研究團隊會進行初步篩選，以了解您是否符合基本參加資格
成功通過初步篩選後，預約檢查時間
前往香港中文大學汾陽體育館參加檢查
如果符合參加條件，將會被隨機分組，正式開展後續正式的生活方式干預計劃
參與地點：
香港中文大學汾陽體育館G02室
如您有任何疑問，可通過以下渠道聯絡這項研究的相關人員：
何小姐
WhatsApp: 94463265
電郵: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[
數據安全聲明
]
所有檢測結果加密儲存，僅供研究團隊匿名分析，您可隨時要求刪除個人資料
[
歡迎邀請身邊感興趣的親友參加
]
Study Purpose:
Central obesity is associated with an increased risk of abnormal glucose regulation, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic health problems. To help address this growing public health concern, the Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is launching a Healthy Lifestyle Program that offers personalized health support for individuals with central obesity.
Recruitment criteria:
Aged between 40 and 64 years
No regular exercise habits
Central obesity: waist circumference ≥ 90 cm for men and ≥ 80 cm for women
Body weight fluctuation ≤5% in the past three months
Not taking any chronic medication
Study arrangement:
Scan the QR code to register (
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
)
The study team will select participants based on the registration information
Arrange a screening time
Arrive at CUHK Kwok Sports Building for the test
If you are eligible, you will be randomly assigned to start the formal Healthy Lifestyle Intervention Program
Study Location:
Room G02, Kwok Sports Building, Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin
Contact Us
If you are interested and have any inquiries, please feel free to contact us:
Ms. He
WhatsApp: 94463265
Email: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[Data safety] All data obtained during the study will be kept strictly confidential
.
[Welcome to invite friends and family who are interested in participating in our study]
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Announcements
[Free of charge] UP TO HKD$1000 ALLOWANCE! Assess the safety, efficacy and tolerability of a CUHK proprietary Chinese medicine formula – A 9-month trial targeting patients with diabetes <6-year disease duration and on diet control / two or less oral drugs 津貼高達一千港元!以確認香港中文大學研發的專利中藥配方的安全性、療效及耐受性。招募糖尿病人(六年內確診，飲食控制或服用2種或以下口服糖尿藥)參與為期九個月的研究 - Department of Medicine and Therapeutics
From: Maggie Lee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
maggielee@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[
新中藥方劑治療
2
型糖尿病的臨床安全性、有效性和多組評價：對
β
細胞功能和胰島素抵抗的影響】
香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期九個月，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至80歲華人
沒有重大疾病 (例如:心臟病或中風等重大併發症)
沒有服用中藥
身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
患糖尿病6 年或以下
目前飲食控制或用2種或以下口服糖尿藥 [例如metformin（品牌藥名：Glucophage）或/及 gliclazide（品牌藥名：Diamicron）]
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，但具備以下其中一項風險因素，我們會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）作篩查
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_1EK8XyC5ac5ykiG
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 9-month clinical study on the use of oral Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 80 years
No major illnesses (e.g., heart disease or stroke)
Not taking Chinese medicine
Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes within the past 6 years
Diet control alone or taking no more than 2 oral diabetes medications [e.g., metformin (Glucophage®) and/or gliclazide (Diamicron®)]
Not sure if you have diabetes? If you have any of the following risk factors, we can arrange a 75 g Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) for diabetes screening
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes

Study Procedures: Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_1EK8XyC5ac5ykiG
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
For inquiries, please contact:
3505 3897 / 6937 3365
WhatsApp: 6937 3365
View Count

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/
